clo_details: Understand the concepts of Reinforcement Learning
Know how to implement dynamic programming as an efficient solution approach to an industrial control problem
Understand several algorithms for estimating value: Temporal-Difference learning, Monte Carlo
Undersatnd and implement a model-based approach to RL: Temporal-Difference, Expected Sarsa, Q-learning
Understand several approaches that affect approximate value functions: supervised learning, fixed basis, neural network.
Understand how function approximation is used to predict and control in Reinforcement Learning
Understand and implement an RL solution to a problem step by step: problem formulation, appropriate algorithm selection, implementation, and empirical study into the effectiveness of the solution.
